channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Drazen Petrovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Drazen Petrovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dino Radja on Toni Kukoc, Arvydas Sabonis, Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic
item.description:
Dino Radja:

“I have to say that I am very proud to be one of the pioneers who opened the road for everybody to NBA. Because, before Drazen Petrovic, Divac, Toni Kukoc, Sabonis, myself… There was no belief in European players…that they can succeed. Afterward, we came in and showed everybody that we can succeed, and now the NBA is open. If you see how many international players are in the NBA right now, it is a huge number.”

Dino Radja on Toni Kukoc, Arvydas Sabonis, Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Nov 5, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Vujacic told ClutchPoints.

“And for me, being European coming from Europe, I understand what the journey was to get here. And when these kids back in the day saw what Vlade [Divac], Drazen [Petrovic], [Arvydas] Sabonis, all the pioneers did — without naming everybody — and then what different generations did, they got excited and they understood that hard work will pay off.”

Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis, Sep 16, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Duckworth, Drazen Petrovic, Jerome Kersey, Cliff Robinson
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Erik Spoelstra on the death of Clifford Robinson,

“If you just look at that team, there's four players that are not with us anymore, starting with Drazen Petrovic, Kersey, Duckworth and now Cliff Robinson. I'm shocked. I'm stunned. And all you can do is send your prayers.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Duckworth, Drazen Petrovic, Jerome Kersey, Cliff Robinson, Aug 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Sarunas Jasikevicius on Drazen Petrovic, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Sarunas Jasikevicius on Luka Doncic to RTV Slo:

“Petrovic and Doncic can be compared in some way. They have similar qualities and talent. Guys from college have no idea of what they are talking about and what Luka Doncic can do”

Sarunas Jasikevicius on Drazen Petrovic, Luka Doncic, Aug 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @ECarchia.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Drazen Petrovic
item.description:
Luka Doncic:

“I knew it, yes. Petrovic was a really good player. It is incredible what he did and what he became. If I ever reach his level, it would be awesome. Drazen's mother asked me for the jersey; she met my Mom, asked for it to put it in Drazen's museum, and I was more than delighted to give it to her.”

Luka Doncic on Drazen Petrovic, May 28, 2018. Source: Euroleague.net.

item.title: Kenny Anderson on Drazen Petrovic
item.description:
“Before Drazen, [it was like the league said] you didn't even want them over here,”

Kenny Anderson on Drazen Petrovic, Feb 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Drazen Petrovic
item.description:
Steph Curry has not forgotten it and he promised to send her a jersey he wore at Finals, according to Patrik Patafta.

“It will be an honor to see my jersey at Drazen's museum,”

Stephen Curry on Drazen Petrovic, Jun 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @BarriHoopsHype.
